name: Alderjaw
lore: An alder-bank beaver who builds bridges by daylight and fells corrupted timber by moonlight.

primary.name: Bite
primary.description: Snap your incisors at enemies directly ahead within 90 units.

secondary.name: Tail Slap
secondary.description: Tap for a tail slap: 26 damage, 80 knockback and 1.2s stun. Hold up to 1.3s to push up to 160 and stun up to 2s; release to strike.

special.name: Timber
special.description: An upright tree shakes and falls over 1.1s, striking a 380-unit line for 65 damage and a 1.8s stun. Walls stop the fall; enemies can escape the warning.

passive: Alder Armour: each different foe you stun grants 2% damage reduction for 8s, up to 20%. Stunning the same foe refreshes its stack.

final_technique.name: Beaver’s Breakwater
final_technique.description: Build a 3s breakwater of six 5-damage pulses with slow. Replaces the falling tree’s big line hit and stun.

attack.name: Beaver’s Breakwater
attack.description: Build a 3s breakwater of six 5-damage pulses with slow. Replaces the falling tree’s big line hit and stun.
